# Newsign Labs: Web design & engineering studio

> Newsign Labs is an independent web design and engineering studio, established in 2024. One senior crew designs and builds brand systems, websites and web apps, 3D and motion experiences, and launch campaigns for ambitious teams.

## Make your next move impossible to miss.

We design and engineer websites, products and brand systems for ambitious teams. Built to load fast, read clearly and move people to act.

Newsign Labs is a small senior studio where the people who design a product are the people who build and launch it. Projects start with a short discovery sprint, reach a clickable prototype within the first weeks, and go into production with performance and accessibility budgets set up front.

## Services: Design, code and host in the same room.

One senior crew across strategy, design and engineering. The people who sketch it are the people who ship it, so nothing gets lost between.

### Brand systems

Identity, type and design systems built to scale cleanly from favicon to billboard, and from your first hire to your fiftieth.

### Websites & web apps

Marketing sites, platforms and SaaS products engineered in React and Next.js: fast, accessible and built to turn visits into pipeline.

### 3D & AI lab

WebGL scenes, product configurators and AI-assisted tools that make complex products instantly legible and genuinely fun to explore.

### Motion & launch

Motion systems, sonic logos and launch campaigns that carry the brand beyond the browser and into feeds, inboxes and pitch rooms.

## Selected work: Selected frequencies.

### New Studio: Albums, Laid Out

*Product platform · Installable web app*

A browser-based studio for designing photo albums and print-ready layered layouts. Photos never leave the device while the layout syncs, AI beautifies pages on request, and a built-in Newlance marketplace lets studios hire layout artists with escrow-protected payouts.

- Scope: Product design / Web app engineering / Payments & escrow / AI tooling
- Result: Album design, freelance hiring and secure payouts in one workflow, instead of three tools and a chat thread.

### Newbrush: One Class, New Skin

*Design framework · Developer tooling*

A token-driven design framework that pairs a full component library with a utility toolkit. Change one class and the whole interface becomes minimal, glassmorphic, neumorphic, neon, cyber or pixel, while a built-in AI bridge lets agents generate on-brand UI on demand.

- Scope: Design tokens / Component library / Design styles / AI-agent tooling
- Result: One markup, six personalities: a team can restyle an entire product by changing a single class instead of rewriting its styles.

### Bizmsgs: Two Channels, One Inbox

*Business messaging · Multi-channel*

One workspace for businesses to message customers on the two chat apps they already use. Team members sign in with a one-time code delivered on the app they choose: no passwords, no SMS bills.

- Scope: Channel integrations / One-time-code sign-in / Templates & consent / Shared inbox
- Result: Templates, bulk sends, a shared reply inbox and delivery tracking across both channels, with per-channel customer consent built in.

## How we work: The work gets better in motion.

### 1. Discovery sprint (Week 1–2): Find the sharp edge

Before a single pixel, we find the one idea worth building around. Short, focused and evidence-led.

What happens:
- Kick-off workshop with your decision makers
- Audience and competitor teardown
- Analytics and funnel audit of what exists today
- Positioning and message hierarchy

What you get:
- Positioning one-pager
- Creative and technical brief
- Success metrics we will be measured on
- Scope and timeline you can plan around

### 2. Prototype & design (Week 2–5): Make it tangible

A clickable prototype in your hands early, so feedback is about the real thing and not a slide.

What happens:
- Wireframes to high-fidelity design in weekly loops
- Interactive prototype tested with real users
- Design system foundations: type, colour, components
- Technical spike for anything risky (3D, integrations, data)

What you get:
- Interactive prototype
- Visual direction and design system
- Content plan and copy drafts
- Build plan with fixed milestones

### 3. Build, launch & amplify (Week 5+): Turn up the signal

We engineer it fast, accessible and measurable, then make sure the right people actually see it.

What happens:
- Production build with performance budgets
- Accessibility and cross-device QA
- Analytics, SEO and CMS hand-over
- Launch campaign, motion assets and outreach

What you get:
- Live product on your domain
- Launch kit: social, motion, email
- Training and documentation
- 90-day growth and iteration plan

## Ways to work: Pick a pace. We bring the momentum.

Start small and prove it, build the whole thing, or keep us on the bench. Every engagement is led by senior people from first call to launch day.

### Launch Sprint (2–4 weeks)

A sharp first version of your brand, landing page or prototype, shipped while the idea is still hot and the budget is still small.

- Brand starter or landing page
- One round of user feedback
- Launch-ready assets
- Clear next-step roadmap

### Product Build (6–12 weeks)

A full website, platform or web app, from discovery to launch, designed and engineered by one senior crew under one contract.

- Discovery, design and build
- Design system and CMS
- 3D, motion and interactions
- Performance and accessibility QA

### Signal Partner (Monthly)

Your embedded design and engineering team for products that ship every month and should get measurably better each time.

- Reserved senior capacity
- Experiments and CRO
- Campaign and content drops
- Monthly growth review

## Frequently asked questions

### How long does a website take?

A focused marketing site usually takes 4–8 weeks from kick-off to launch. Larger products and web apps run 8–12 weeks, and we ship a working prototype in the first few weeks either way.

### How do you price projects?

We scope every project after a short call, then quote a fixed price per phase so there are no surprise invoices. Ongoing partnerships are a simple monthly fee for reserved capacity.

### Can you work with our existing team or codebase?

Yes. We regularly slot in alongside in-house designers and engineers, work in your repositories and follow your conventions, or hand over cleanly documented code to your team.

### Will our site be fast, even with 3D and motion?

Performance is part of the design. We set budgets up front, lazy-load heavy scenes, respect reduced-motion settings and test on real mid-range phones before launch.

### What happens after launch?

You get training, documentation and 30 days of included support. Many clients keep us on as a Signal Partner to run experiments, add features and keep the brand moving.

## Contact: Have a good problem?

Tell us what you are building, what is stuck, or what should exist but does not yet. Within two working days you will get a senior reply with a first useful thought, not a sales script.

Start a project with the brief form in the Contact section of newsignlabs.in, or message the studio from the WhatsApp or Arattai buttons on the site. A senior person replies with a first useful thought within two working days.
